title: The subtlety of simple eyes: the tuning of visual fields to perceptual challenges in birds
journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B 369(1636): 20130040
why: Review of bird visual fields (abstract page opened). It may tabulate field widths for many passerines, which could include a warbler genus; no species list was reachable, so Cettia is a possibility only.

title: Ocular dimensions and schematic eyes of freshwater and sea turtles
why: Cited in Hauzman et al 2018 (opened) as the source for eye dimensions of freshwater turtles; if Clemmys or another emydid is among the species, axial length and schematic-eye focal length would give a sampling angle. Species list not seen.

title: Retinal photoreceptors of paleognathous birds: the ostrich (Struthio camelus) and rhea (Rhea americana)
why: Published version of the thesis logged here for Rhea (lambda max pooled with the ostrich in the thesis abstract). It would give the rhea-only cone peaks, including whether the short-wave cone is violet or ultraviolet sensitive, which sets the spectral range.
